subject.title: fix(canvas): bound A2UI JSONL file reads

question: Should Canvas enforce the Gateway limit from the actual encoded invocation, or intentionally expose a smaller documented raw-file contract that is safe for every valid JSONL payload?
rationale: A raw byte ceiling cannot generally account for JSON string escaping, so choosing the durable compatibility contract requires owner intent rather than a mechanical cap adjustment.

options.title: Preflight the encoded request
options.body: Retain the bounded reader and reject only when the real Gateway request encoding exceeds its frame budget, preserving compatible large payloads.

options.title: Publish a conservative raw limit
options.body: Choose a substantially smaller raw-file cap that is safe under worst-case escaping and document that A2UI constraint.

recommendation.title: Preflight the encoded request
recommendation.body: Retain the bounded reader and reject only when the real Gateway request encoding exceeds its frame budget, preserving compatible large payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest branch correction directly addresses the transport-budget policy that now needs an explicit contract decision.
